parts.text: School taught you the wrong lesson.
Sit still. Wait for instructions. Raise your hand. Don't make mistakes.
Follow every rule, and you get a good grade.
But real life doesn't hand out instructions.
Nobody tells you when to start. Nobody grades your effort. Nobody checks your homework.
The people who win didn't wait for permission.
They started before they felt ready, made mistakes, and learned faster.
So unlearn it. Stop waiting for someone to tell you it's time.
